cards.hint: Focus on which loyal states kept slavery under the order
cards.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.
cards.stem: Where did the Proclamation leave slavery untouched

cards.hint: Look for what had already come under federal control
cards.quote: It also expressly exempted parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control.
cards.stem: Which areas were expressly left out after coming under federal control

cards.hint: Think about what military outcome freedom waited for
cards.quote: Most important, the freedom it promised depended upon Union military victory.
cards.stem: What did the freedom promised by the Proclamation depend upon

cards.hint: Recall who could newly join the army and navy
cards.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
cards.stem: Which group did the Proclamation announce would be accepted into military service
